notes: Colouring in: all the pictures redrawn with thicker lines, friendlier faces and a little scene behind each one.
Six new pictures to colour: owl, castle, turtle, teddy, bee and ladybird (22 in all).
Fixed: pressing refresh (F5) could bring back an old version of the app, including the stray 'false'. Old saved copies are now cleared out.
Updates now apply by themselves: the app reloads on the home screen after a new version arrives, so there is no need to close and reopen it.
Paint: Colouring in. Choose from 16 outline pictures and colour them with the paint bucket (fills a whole area) or the brush. Coloured pictures save to the gallery and can be reopened to carry on.
Two more colours: white and skin.
New game: Shopping list. Fill the basket to match the list. Level 1 find the things, level 2 count how many of each, level 3 add up the prices in pence.
Times tables icon now shows a sum (2 × 3 = 6) instead of a cross.
The grown-ups button moved to the top right, next to the sound button.
New button at the top of the home screen: hover over it (or tap it) to see whether all the files are saved for offline use.
Drawn pictures: the home tiles, the games, the phonics menu and all 71 phonics words now have drawn pictures instead of emoji.
Games remember an unfinished game. Open the game and tap Carry on, or throw it away.
Home tiles now fit on shorter screens.
Fixed: new versions now reach the installed app (before, the offline helper never noticed an update, so old screens could keep showing).
Offline check now says when a new version is waiting and the app needs closing and reopening.
Paint: the pointer is now a clear ring (white with a black edge) showing where and how big the brush is, so it can be seen on any colour.
Numbers: 11 Year 1 activities (counting, one more or less, number bonds, adding, taking away, doubles, halves). Tap the answer; each round of 10 earns 1 to 3 stars and the best is remembered.
Phonics: three activities using only the sounds ticked as learned (first sound, build the word, read and match). No audio yet.
Paint: free drawing that fills the screen, 12 colours, 3 brush sizes, rubber, undo and clear. Save to a gallery, reopen to keep painting, delete pictures.
Write: a simple note with big text in the Andika font, 4 text sizes and 10 colours. It saves by itself.
Games: Noughts and Crosses, Connect 4, Snakes and Ladders and Ludo, against people or computer players (levels 1 to 10), with house rules you can change before each game.
She can make her own game players (a person or a computer) in Games.
A thinking icon shows when the computer is working out its move.
Fixed a stray 'false' on the home screen, and similar stray text in some grown-ups screens.
First version: home screen with six app tiles (apps coming soon).
Grown-ups area behind a sum: her name and picture, phonics sounds learned, game players, backup and restore, offline check.
Works offline once opened; sound button; keyboard and gamepad navigation.
